{'message':'Extract a source-faithful incident semantic model from this investigation report. Report Markdown:

' & input.incident_report,'instructions':'Return only facts, relationships, verdicts, impacts, priorities, and actions explicitly asserted by the source document. Use stable concise ids and reference only ids declared in this response.','maxOutputTokens':10000}

Then return two or three alternative projection candidates that reference those items by id. Available primitives are hero-signal, metric-strip, signal-list, timeline, evidence-list, and narrative. Available priority tokens are primary, secondary, and tertiary. Available disclosure tokens are always, collapsed, and on-demand. Use only this catalog. A glanceable candidate should expose no more than three always-visible sections and lead with the most material signal. A focused candidate may retain evidence and supporting detail through progressive disclosure. The runtime recipe, not you, chooses the active candidate. Analyze only the supplied portfolio data; do not imply that external news or events were researched. Distinguish supplied facts, judgments, and uncertainty through semantic item kinds. Return no evidence unless it was supplied in the request. Keep the complete structured response within the supplied output token budget.','maxOutputTokens':2500}

causalChain.text: Morgan redirects the method while preserving the original revision.
Policy blocks DC-01 isolation and preserves useful work safely.
Morgan recommends the revised Host-A plan without exceeding analyst authority.
Priya supplies the required Incident Commander authority.
Response Agent isolates Host-A and records the outcome.

taxJourney: Documents establish an initial tax position
An agent proposes an optimization with source and policy citations
A policy change invalidates part of the strategy
The kernel recomputes while the agent replans
Filing remains blocked behind human confirmation
expansion.boundary: Beat 4 proves remote, transported, and headless continuity. The current SOC runtime proves deterministic in-process collaboration; it does not prove durable remote clients or background agents.
